name: @referralplatform/patient-mobile
description: Patient/carer mobile app (Expo/React Native) — the primary patient-facing surface: onboarding, dashboard, referral detail/timeline, booking, new-GP approval, consent & security, raise a concern, document vault. See claude/ui-design.md.
private_notes: Pinned to typescript ^5.6.3 (not the newer 7.x line on the registry) for consistency with the rest of the monorepo, and because ts-jest (used everywhere else) does not yet support TS 7 — see root CONVENTIONS.md. jest is pinned to ^29.7.0 here (matching the rest of the monorepo, which was itself downgraded from 30.x to 29.x specifically because jest-expo@57 depends on @jest/globals ^29.x and mixing 29/30 across one npm-workspace node_modules tree causes hoisting collisions — see root CONVENTIONS.md, 'Testing convention'). @testing-library/react-native is pinned to ^13.3.3 (not the newer 14.x line) because 14.x switched its peer dependency to the brand-new `test-renderer` package instead of the classic `react-test-renderer`, and that combination did not render correctly against jest-expo@57's own bundled (older) react-test-renderer in this build's testing — 13.x's classic react-test-renderer peer is the combination that was actually verified to pass here.
